text:
Tess: Morning — weird PSA: there’s a faint burnt popcorn smell and a small oil stain near the espresso station. Did someone try to flambé a biscotti? :popcorn:
Ibrahim: guilty re: biscotti reheating, but I swear I didn't burn anything. I did notice the espresso tamper handle is loose and half the base fell off...
Tess: ahhh that explains the clunk noises. It was making a rattling sound around 8pm last night.
Riya: I can bring a spare tamper from home tomorrow AM. Also, can we agree on a "kitchen toolkit" box for small fixes? screwdrivers, spare pumps, tamper, measuring scoop.
Connor: yes toolbox = good. I'll add a small label: TOOLKIT (top shelf) and keep a basic kit. Also, let's please not use the steam wand to clean out pastry crumbs — it overfills the drip tray.
Elaine: on composting — we have no liner in the countertop composter and the bin smells funky. Suggestion: clear sticker "COMPOST ONLY - NO OIL" and a weekly emptying rota. Who's up for taking the first two weeks?
Ibrahim: I can take week 1. Connor week 2.
Riya: I'll make the sticker and laminate it. Also proposing a monthly "Snack Amnesty" where people can bring surplus snacks to share before they expire. Put them in the "FREE" box, date them with a sticky.
Tess: love Snack Amnesty. One ask: please mark home-brought sauces (chutney, oils) with initials + date so allergies are clear.
Elaine: noted. I'll order compost liners (biodegradable) and a small deodorizer pack. kitchen-bot, inventory check?
kitchen-bot: Inventory scan: espresso beans (2 bags), ground decaf (1), tamper (1 - damaged), compost liners (0), oat milk (2), pumps (5). Low items: compost liners, decaf. Recommended actions: order liners x1 box, replace tamper.
Connor: ordering liners + a new commercial tamper today. ETA Wednesday.
Riya: sticker mockup (will print 8): ```COMPOST RULES
• Food scraps only (no grease/oil)
• Line with compost bag
• Empty into green bin every Friday
• If you start a mess, wipe it now
```
Tess: thanks all — cleaning the drip tray now and will put a sticky on the tamper: "BROKEN - DO NOT USE" until replacement arrives. :white_check_mark:
